purpose: the objective asks for an independent repeat to verify the accepted gain is stable. This is that repeat: the registered lane rerun once, unchanged, in the shipping configuration.
what_this_means: the 14.2876 tok/s registration is not a lucky pair. A fresh run of the same configuration lands 0.13% below the registered mean and inside the spread that the three registration pairs themselves showed. The graph configuration and the FP32 parity were re-observed identically, so the repeat also independently confirms the round-75 finding that the inline one-layer capture is the shipping configuration.
what_is_not_claimed: this is not a new optimisation and it does not move the registered number. It is a reproducibility check on the existing one, and it introduces no change of any kind.
method: one bounded run of the unmodified launcher under a fresh lease receipt, with the run's own teardown reporting zero live owned processes
